essence: The contemplative structure includes five-spoked, eight-petaled, and sixteen-spoked beautiful forms.
Further contemplative configurations of eight-spoked lotus petals and a sixteen-plus-one form are taught to the goddess.
The self is to be understood as breath-united and differentiated through sixteen syllables.
The self must always be understood as four-parted and never otherwise.
After placing the self in the pericarp, one should flood it by means of the upper wheel.
